article.headline: Nowell's 17 lead Portland State past Northwest Indian 110-48
article.description: — Shane Nowell had 17 points in Portland State's 110-48 win over Northwest Indian on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Nowell's 17 lead Portland State past Northwest Indian 110-48

categories.description: Northwest Indian RedHawks @ Portland State Vikings

event.description: Northwest Indian RedHawks @ Portland State Vikings

keywords: Northwest Indian RedHawks @ Portland State Vikings
article.story: PORTLAND, Ore. -- — Shane Nowell had 17 points in Portland State's 110-48 win over Northwest Indian on Saturday night. Nowell also added six rebounds for the Vikings (5-5). Jaylin Henderson finished 7 of 8 from the field to add 15 points. Qiant Myers had 13 points and shot 5 of 8 from the field and 2 for 5 from the line. Mycole Rodriguez finished with 16 points and six rebounds for the Eagles. Tyasin Burns added 16 points for Northwest Indian. Anthony Snow also had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
